小体量卡牌rogue游戏。 没有局外元素，目前只有2个角色。 通过击败敌人或者商店购买获取技能、条件、遗物（被动）。 两个角色有不同的技能，给技能设置释放顺序、条件然后自动打怪。 流程短，内容较少，未来可期。

Simple to pick up, hard to master, and has all the utlity and features to actually make it pleasant to play such as directly showing how much damage you take and how many rounds your current setup takes to win, alongside the ability to start over a fight as many times as you want so you can experiment. its a game about using your tools to the fullest effect since a single condition can be the difference between losing and winning in a single round, great stuff.

打个中评，玩起来很爽但是平衡性很差。目前打了两个职业Lv4，感受就是不同流派差别巨大。有的像叠甲和召唤就是轮椅。以及作者虽然做了40次技能的限制，但是特定的循环依旧可以爆死对面，比如一刀80的魔力爆发打上40次这种限制真的有意义吗？而且组件甚至只有3张刚需卡。而有的流派比如吸血和连击脸不好第一层都出不去。 最后就是，第一层的苹果难度比第二第三层的都高，还磨轮次。 打完Lv5了追评一下，最终boss确实难度高了些。不过很难想象处理叠甲、吸血和召唤以外有流派能过。

[h1]TL;DR[/h1] An auto battler with copy-pasted skills from Slay the Spire that likes wasting your time. [h1]Slay the Spire... at home.[/h1] You basically do the same thing: pick up skills, artifacts, upgrade them, encounter shops and enemies. The thing is, most of the skills and items I saw felt like a literal Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V from Slay the Spire, without any adjustments or added flavor. [h2]But it's an auto battler, right?[/h2] I mean, you tell me. At first, you think it's cool you have so many conditions and things you can configure. But the longer you play, the more it starts to annoy you. You'll need to adjust your skills before each battle, and the time you spend doing that adds up. You spend much more time adjusting the skills than it takes to just play the cards yourself. Instead of delivering a fatal blow yourself, you now have to adjust your setup to do it for you. It feels clunky and pointless. All this tweaking makes your run much longer than it needs to be. You think to yourself: Why am I playing this, doing all this bs just to set up the behavior for a single enemy, when I could just play the cards myself? [h1]UI is the biggest boss[/h1] UI is garbo, straight up. The arena takes too little space, models barely fit there. No UI scaling, everything is too big, like it's made for grandpas. Text is a terrible pixelated mess, barely readable, and you can't change it to a normal one. You can't mute skills you don't need for the current fight.

This game is alright to kill a little time, turn down the high pitch 8-bit music and its pretty chill. However, within 8 hours of play I've come across 3 different bugs that were not just translation issues, and stopped my runs dead in their tracks. Game could use some more polish.

转差评了，几个月没更新，不会这样就是完全版吧...完全就只有demo的内容量。 好玩！ 如名字所示，是auto战斗，但怎样auto呢？ 和一般的弱智ai不一样，这款游戏是让你自己写各种条件，在什么样的情况下使用什么样的技能，换句话说，就是自己在游戏内写脚本。 各种条件非常自由，虽然暂时体验还不多，但也体验到了两个角色完全不同的战斗、成长模式，在同一个角色内也有多种玩法搭配，可以说相当值得入手。 啊，对了，这游戏没中文，日语或者英语不够好的朋友最好还是多等等，因为机制复杂，不是看简单的教程就能快速上手的。

编程自走棋真好玩啊，看上去很简单但是通过角色特性、战场谜面、技能+触发特性的组合可以触发超级多意想不到的效果，Programming的味道很重，当自己脑内构想的想法被验证的时候也能切实地体验到爽快感！ 以及最重要的是游戏只在机制和思考层面设置难度，并没有在实际流程里给玩家增加太大的压力，当局游戏随时可以重开，玩家可以不断试验和打磨精进自己的想法，说实话这样放低门槛的做法是真的能激励到我去尝试更多解题组合寻找最优解。 可惜的是目前只有日语和英语，期待汉化版本和后续更新内容。

Right now, this is a really cool proof-of-concept, with no meat on the bones. I like AutoRogue quite a bit, but there's very little variety between runs, even as the difficulty scales up, and once you hit a solution that wins a battle on turn one or two, nothing really stands in your way to make your strategy evolve. Even if there were some greater challenge to overcome, the player's tools just aren't there to effect radically different strategies. Still, there are many games worth a lot less than this one. I can think of worse ways to spend seven bucks and a couple hours.
Was having a lot of fun with a comp and then after a fight the game ended. Would enjoy it more if there was an infinite game mode to test your build even further.
可玩性非常高，但是易用性有优化空间，我游玩过程中比较不满的地方主要有两个：1.plan和技能遗物界面太小了，需要经常翻页很麻烦；2.部分词条不知是不是语言障碍问题我没法完全理解，希望有更详细的词条说明或百科。 此外，平衡性也有待调整。现有数值体系下，叠甲不方便的流派很难玩下去。

2026.3.24：过了这么久了，依然不做一个保存方式，也不做任何更新，真让人无语，我非常想差评，即使一个不贵的小游戏，你至少也做个保存的功能吧 ------------------------------------------ 首先说一下对本作最不满的一点：为什么不能加个保存的按钮！而且也没有自动存档！难道要求玩家每次玩都玩到底吗（捂脸）？我中途有事退出一下都不行，好不容易搭配好的套路就这么没了，还是两次！求求了，做个保存功能吧！ 下面是正经测评： 本作主要讲述一只调皮的猫幼崽有一日逃出猫妈的看护，不断远离猫妈，四处游玩大杀四方的故事（笑）。游戏中玩家控制一只小猫，游玩目的可以简单理解为努力逃出最远的距离，不要被猫妈抓到。 本作在玩法机制有些像香草社的《圣兽之王》。每场战斗前对魔法猫进行编程，使其针对不同的状态做出相对应的行动，在Coding结束后开战，猫猫和敌人会自动互相按照设定好的策略进行战斗。编程是通过技能模块/物品模块+条件模块来实现的，同时结合了编程中嵌套的思路，虽然我没有尝试可以嵌套多少层，但是3层是肯定可以的。在Coding时，游戏中会跟随玩家的编程实时显示在此种编程下玩家将受到的伤害值。在每次战斗后，如果不满意，玩家还可以无限次的重写代码。在战斗过程中，玩家也可以像调试代码一样，让战斗过程一步一步的进行，以编辑更优秀的策略，这就使得优化代码成为了可能。并且如果能在战斗中做到无伤，系统还会掉落额外的宝箱，增加玩家的优势。这就刺激玩家优化自己的“代码”，越到后面越要求玩家熟悉技能的同时还增加一些程序上的复杂度，不能只无脑的堆叠一堆高级技能（虽然简单模式下应该也可以啦）。 本作地图的机制几乎可以理解为横板的《Slay the Spire》，猫猫可以通过击败敌人，获得金币以及新的物品，技能和条件，用金币可以增加自己编程的空间，也可以理解为增加自己代码编辑的空间，能让自己写更多的内容。还可以使用金币在商人处进行购买和升级，路途中也有篝火，能让玩家进行回血/技能升级/物品升级/以及增加与猫妈妈的距离。这个与猫妈的距离也是该游戏中一个比较创新的一点，由于小猫是逃出来的，猫妈在后面不断地追赶。开局时小猫与猫妈的距离为10，每场战斗都会视战斗回合数缩短或增加这段距离。距离为0时，意味着游戏结束（小猫要被带回去打屁股了）。并且需要注意的是，如果战斗回合数超过10回合，猫妈妈也会追上小猫，将其一顿训斥和暴打并带回家中。而每次自动战斗前，游戏都会给出一个猫妈可能缩短的距离，如果击败敌方的回合数足够小，这段距离则可能会增加。 说实话这游戏玩熟悉了说实话还是非常的上瘾的，尤其是每次针对每一个怪的打法编一个套路，看着自己的套路把怪玩弄于股掌之中，那种充分掌握战场态势的感觉真是爽的不要不要的。但是由于每场战斗敌我双方都只有一人，而且地图完全固定，不能自己选择线路。感觉少了很多策略和选择的可玩性。《圣兽之王》中的战斗就是5v5的小队级别的战斗，而且结合三国志一样的大地图移动系统和装备系统，策略复杂度可以很高。不过本作的优势在于，其编程的复杂度高于《圣兽之王》，因为本作只注重为一个角色编程。通关后还能再开启一只魔法小黑猫作为可玩角色，整个游戏中技能，条件和物品加起来有大概40-50个左右，算是比较丰富。但整个游戏一共只有3关，每关4到5只怪，虽说各种怪物的攻击方式和频率不固定，让人可以去探索，但玩过几次之后基本已经记住了怪物的打法，后面再遇见时就毫无新奇感和挑战性了。所以以目前的状态来看内容终归还是太少了，只能当闲暇时的小品游戏玩一玩。真的希望制作者能在后面更新更多的角色和怪物种类，多个角色可以联合作战这种事估计在这代不可能实现了我就不指望了。不过最重要的我觉得还是先开发一个保存功能，不能保存进度简直对我这种没什么大块时间玩的人来说太要命了！！ PLS GIVE US A SAVE BUTTON, PLS!!!! 总体意见：推荐 总体评分：8分

I really want to recommend this game. It is an amazing concept, lots of fun figuring out combos and learning how to game works. However, I absolutely BLASTED through both normal and hard modes and after playing around some more on the scaling difficulty, I just don't see any reason to continue playing; there is no more content to do outside of "beat the game" or anything to unlock. I was hoping to sink many hours into this game, but I am choosing to refund it instead. Had this been an early access game, I would probably continue to play, but seeing as "this is it", I can't currently recommend it. I'll definitely come back sometime, if there is ever any content updates.

Best min-maxing game in 2025! My only problem with this game is that the translation or the descriptions could be a little bit better. Otherwise, I feel like this is on the same level as Slay the Spire — very unique for sure!
Game is so much fun, the only issue i have with it is that i genuinely want more content. More characters and skills and enemies would be amazing.
好游戏，爽 每种bd有自己的快乐，但是叠盾还没赢过 没试过低难度，直接从最高开始玩的 遗憾的发现LV5是最后了，把两个角色的LV5都通了 要是有更多角色或者更多难度就好了！

Fun game. However I feel like the "No complicated controls" note in the store description is almost a bad joke. It's not a lie, the game does have very simple controls. The problem is, and I get the feeling this applies mostly to the English translation of the game, the the way that skills work is often described... roughly. You can fit a lot more Kanji in the description boxes, so space constraints may be the culprit here, but it leads to skills behaving in ways that you wouldn't expect from reading the description and skills and passives that aren't described well enough to know what their actual effect is. This ironically complicates the game greatly, and not in a good way. That being said, the game's got a lovely style and the game actually is pretty fun even with the issues with understanding what does what. The auto-battling system is fun and the game has is great for the type of game that you can pick up, play for a bit, then put down and return later. It's pretty fun mixing and matching builds. I'd love to see more of it, Plus I mean for the price it's great. Probably even more-so if you can read Japanese. Either way, I'd still recommend it.

I recommend you buy the game for like $2... It was a lot of fun. I beat it in my first run on normal, unlocked another character. I beat it with the other character in my first run on normal and unlocked nothing.... The developer notes that "In this game, it’s not the character that gets stronger, but the player" and the problem here is that I'm already too strong. In both runs I was defeating bosses in one turn with no damage taken. I guess the harder difficulties may add something...? I don't know. I like the game! It has a fun look, good UI, a fun premise... I liked it immediately and it really scratched an itch... but only for an hour. I want more: other characters, meta-progression to unlock new skills, longer adventures... there just isn't enough replay value. There aren't even achievements.

The builds are much too on rails. There is little in the way of player expression or meaningful choices. The difficulty mainly scales in just raising the numbers, which means the harder modes are just about efficiency instead of adapting. Most of it's problems could be circumvented if there was a large selection of characters, so you could learn one character and then move to another. I was surprised there appears to be only one thing to unlock. Not a lot of reason to dive back in. Felt like I'd seen it all in a couple of hours. Unfortunately, not soon enough to get a refund.
Way too easy and way too short, though the idea is very nice

The game is quite easy if you're experienced with roguelites and there are only two characters to experiment with, both of which have a limited set of cards. I ran out of content I had any desire to engage with pretty much in one sitting after one-turn killing the final boss three times in a row on the second hardest difficulty. Aside from that there are some cards that sound really cool but do not work literally at all, and some that aren't translated fully. The gameplay is something I am very interested in, but it needs way, way more flesh and challenge to keep me engaged. For $7 i guess it's alright but I wouldn't make the purchase again.
虽然游戏很好玩，但是就两个角色，内容还是少了，高难度数值卡的也很死，很多流派玩不了 给个中评吧

Man did I want to recommend this, the bones that are here are fantastic - there's just a few too many problems to give it a resounding thumbs up. The core gameplay is great, with fun synergies to experiment with and the always-fun number-go-up itch scratch for your brain, but there's just not enough. With only two characters, pretty limited numbers of skills per character, and a very limited number of enemies and stages per run (and no endless mode that I can see), along with pretty low difficulty, you'll see everything the game has very quickly. The slightly wobbly translation is easy to overlook, but it's just not enough really. Doesn't look like there's been any update for quite a few months now, too, so I'm not really all that hopeful that more is coming. Fun game! Just needs a lot more of the good juice it's packing.

The concept is nice & fun, but the game seem unfinished and it lacks a lot of content. I played one hour, and it feel like there is nothing more to discover, it's disappointing. I hope the devs came back to this game, but for now it's not worth more than a few bucks.

I can't actually recommend this for the amount of content, but I really liked the game itself. No endless really hurts. I feel like a lot of builds get online, but don't mature by run end. There is a build which gets online soon enough for a perfect run at least. Variance was much higher on the initial character and the second character it seemed easy enough to essentially force runs through. Edit: I have now had a literally perfect run(0 excess turns, 1 turn every enemy, maximum difficulty level) and I think only the mage can do it. The first character is weaker at every stage of the game, has inferior synergies, and due to having fewer powerful setups has much higher variance. It needs a lot of help.
Pretty fun! The game design is quite unique, I like it a lot.
Mechanically delicious, but light on content.

我们需要中文！！ WE NEED CHINESE!! （虽然我觉得因为像素字体的问题它永远不会有中文） A simple yet cute programing roguelike experience. Aesthetics + Cute pixel art & character design + Japanese style humor + Simple (somehow cheap) but very compelling animation / VFX - UI layout could be a bit less redundant Gameplay + Programing-based battle is a novel design to try out + 2 playable characters, both with multiple builds and are all very unique + In the late game you could reach very insane builds - Certain combos of relics + skills are just too powerful and are somehow not generally good for other builds so it's becoming a game of waiting for certain relic / skill and brainrotly win rather than do something with what you have. - Easy to build simple / basic loop, but for certain boss with certain mechanics it suddenly goes to pro-level programming which also very hard to debug. The learning curve should be more smooth here. - The whole experience is very fixed, you always encountered with the same enemy.

[h1]I Wanted To Love This Game[/h1] i played this game with the hopes of there being more than 2 characters, or at least SOME kind of meta progression (like a roguelike!) when i realized it didn't i was already over the 2 hour mark, no refunds, so i'm leaving a negative review instead. i REALLY wanted this game to be one of my favorite games. i really did. it's just there's literally no progression at all. you play, you code, you either steamroll or die. less nuance than wanted, and worse yet it feels like the second character has LESS need for coding, making the point of the game less and less clear! as other people in the reviews have pointed out: this is certainly one of the types of games that would have benefited with MOD support out the gate. or a dedicated "tool" in the game to build with. not having this means this game has a [u]shelf life[/u]. that saddens me, since this game has sat dormant now for months, years, without a proper content update or a promise of one, a [b]dead game on release[/b]. Please properly update the game and i will change my review to be positive.
note even close to enough complexity, difficulty, or content.

I hate copied reviews, but this one here sums it up perfectly! https://steamcommunity.com/id/Ch1ffar10/recommended/3553210 "Way too easy and way too short, though the idea is very nice." It's the gameplay of FFXII but without anything else, just items and strategy. I do NOT recommend it at the asking price of 7€ though.

This has been on my pile of shame for a while. My brain very much loves the conditional skill building. The amount of different effects and synergies would make most bullethells blush in shame. I just really wish the game had a few achivements. Maybe finish a run on each character. Or something rewarding me when I manage to break synergies into casting 40 skill each turn. It also seems very short for the price? Is there supposed to be a 3rd character that I unlock? I'm really disappointed that this isn't in early access state because that means that I likely won't see any updates on it. There is also no endless mode, or leaderboard, so I currently struggle to find the motivation to do any serious indepth optimisation. Keep that in mind. Maybe buy on sale.
One of the best games I've ever played. I hope there would be an update or a newer version. I loved this game so much!

Game is fun but you've basically seen everything it has to offer in a couple of runs. It's got a few fun insanity builds but they're far too easy to get online and once they are there is very little reason to do anything but hit next until the end game screen. There only seems to be two characters and each one has basically one gimmick. You build around that gimmick. There are like 1-2 viable, kinda obvious ways to do it. Once you do you break the balance of the game and you win, regardless of difficulty. I saw it all in 2.2 hours. Which is actually really fun the first run or two but just outside the refund window I realized the game wasn't going to unlock anything new. That was it.
好！

A brilliant think-y programming style roguelike with a plentiful amount of jank
EN in link. 試行錯誤性、リプレイ性が高くて面白いローグライク。自動化して「再生」をするだけでバトルは進行するので、事前に最適なマクロを組む感じ。難易度やキャラ、スキル、条件、レリックが多数あり、組み合わせ方も多岐に亘るだけでなくスキルの再生順がすごく大事。特に強敵とのバトルではゲーム理解度が試される。まずは体験版を触ってみてほしい。
